findings.summary: parseUnifiedDiff uses the file path as the Map key (hunks.set(currentFile, ...)), causing multiple hunks in the same file to overwrite each other and leaving only the last hunk.
findings.suggested_fix: Change ParsedUnifiedDiff.hunks to store an array of hunks per file (Map<string, ParsedHunk[]>) or use hunk.identity as the map key.

findings.summary: findHunkForLine unconditionally returns the hunk at the end of the function, bypassing the line bounds check and erroneously matching any line to the file's hunk.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the final return statement to return undefined instead of hunk.

findings.summary: findDeclaration returns only the matched symbol name (match[1]) instead of the full declaration source line, resulting in unhelpful string context for the LLM.
findings.suggested_fix: Return lineContent instead of match[1] when a declaration is found.

findings.summary: selectPrReviewContext incorrectly adds the filePath to the includedHunks set instead of hunk.identity, losing the specific hunk attribution.
